author: Paul
authorNote: The letter names Paul as author. Many modern scholars think 1 and 2 Timothy and Titus were written by a follower of Paul after his death; many others hold that Paul wrote them.
audience: Timothy, leading the church in Ephesus
overview: Paul guides his younger colleague Timothy on leading a church: opposing false teaching, prayer, qualities for leaders, and care for widows. "Fight the good fight of the faith."
storyPlace: One of the "pastoral letters" to church leaders.
